FR1.name: Conforming
FR1.explanation: The requirement uses the prohibited construction 'shall be able to' instead of the standard 'The system shall [imperative verb]' pattern.

FR1.name: Unambiguous
FR1.explanation: The article 'a point mass' and 'an origin point' are indefinite, while the notes define one specific point mass and one specific origin; indefinite articles allow multiple interpretations.
FR1.affected_text: a point mass from an origin point
FR1.suggested_replacement: the point mass from the origin point

FR2.name: Conforming
FR2.explanation: The requirement uses the prohibited construction 'shall be able to' rather than a direct imperative verb.

PR1.name: Unambiguous
PR1.explanation: The qualitative adverb 'accurately' is redundant and undefined alongside the quantified tolerance, and 'every Cartesian direction' does not state the reference coordinate frame.
PR1.affected_text: accurately with +/- 2.5mm [0.1”] accuracy in every Cartesian direction
PR1.suggested_replacement: with a positional error of ±2.5 mm [0.1 in] along each of the X, Y, and Z axes of the coordinate frame of Figure 1

PR1.name: Correct
PR1.explanation: The ±2.5 mm tolerance has no traceable basis in the ConOps, project context, or any cited engineering analysis.

PR1.name: Conforming
PR1.explanation: Referencing another requirement ID in place of the action makes the statement non-self-contained, and 'shall execute FR1 accurately' is not the standard imperative-verb structure; spacing of the unit '2.5mm' is also non-conforming.
PR1.suggested_replacement: shall place the point mass at the destination point within ±2.5 mm

PR2.name: Unambiguous
PR2.explanation: 'accurately' is an undefined qualitative descriptor and the coordinate reference frame for 'every Cartesian direction' is not stated.
PR2.affected_text: accurately with +/- 2.5mm [0.1”] accuracy in every Cartesian direction
PR2.suggested_replacement: with a positional error of ±2.5 mm [0.1 in] along each of the X, Y, and Z axes of the coordinate frame of Figure 1

PR2.name: Correct
PR2.explanation: The ±2.5 mm return tolerance is not traceable to the ConOps, project context, or any supporting analysis.

PR2.name: Conforming
PR2.explanation: The statement relies on a requirement ID instead of an imperative action and uses non-conforming unit spacing.
PR2.suggested_replacement: shall return the point mass to the origin point within ±2.5 mm

PR3.name: Conforming
PR3.explanation: Uses both the prohibited 'shall be able to' construction and the prohibited 'no more than' phrasing.
PR3.affected_text: shall be able to execute FR1 in no more than 30 seconds
PR3.suggested_replacement: shall complete the displacement of the point mass to the destination point within 30 seconds

PR3.name: Correct
PR3.explanation: The 30-second maximum duration is not traceable to any stated stakeholder need, ConOps statement, or supporting analysis.

PR4.name: Conforming
PR4.explanation: Uses the prohibited 'shall be able to' construction and the prohibited 'no less than' phrasing.
PR4.affected_text: shall be able to execute FR1 in no less than 5 seconds
PR4.suggested_replacement: shall complete the displacement of the point mass to the destination point in 5 seconds or more

PR4.name: Correct
PR4.explanation: The 5-second minimum duration has no traceable justification in the provided context or any cited analysis.

PR4.name: Necessary
PR4.explanation: A minimum execution time is not derived from any stated need or ConOps operation; its purpose (e.g., limiting imparted loads on ISS) is not established.
PR4.suggested_replacement: in 5 seconds or more, to limit imparted acceleration loads on the ISS [cite need]

PR5.name: Conforming
PR5.explanation: Uses both the prohibited 'shall be able to' construction and the prohibited 'no more than' phrasing.
PR5.affected_text: shall be able to execute FR2 in no more than 30 seconds
PR5.suggested_replacement: shall complete the return of the point mass to the origin point within 30 seconds

PR5.name: Correct
PR5.explanation: The 30-second limit is not traceable to the ConOps, project context, or supporting engineering work.

PR6.name: Conforming
PR6.explanation: Uses the prohibited 'shall be able to' construction and the prohibited 'no less than' phrasing.
PR6.affected_text: shall be able to execute FR2 in no less than 5 seconds
PR6.suggested_replacement: shall complete the return of the point mass to the origin point in 5 seconds or more

PR6.name: Correct
PR6.explanation: The 5-second minimum has no stated traceability to a need, ConOps element, or analysis.

PR6.name: Necessary
PR6.explanation: The need for a lower bound on the return duration is not established by any stakeholder need or ConOps statement.
PR6.suggested_replacement: in 5 seconds or more, to limit imparted acceleration loads on the ISS [cite need]

PR7.name: Conforming
PR7.explanation: Uses the prohibited 'shall be able to' construction and contains a unit typo (acceleration written as 'm/s2' instead of m/s²).
PR7.affected_text: shall be able to move a point mass of 3.6 kg perpendicularly to normal gravity (9.81 m/s2)
PR7.suggested_replacement: shall move a 3.6 kg point mass along a path perpendicular to a gravitational acceleration of 9.81 m/s²

PR7.name: Unambiguous
PR7.explanation: 'normal gravity' and 'perpendicularly to normal gravity' are undefined terms with no stated direction reference (Figure 1 defines gravity along -Y), allowing multiple interpretations.
PR7.suggested_replacement: along a path perpendicular to the gravity vector (-Y axis of Figure 1) under an acceleration of 9.81 m/s²

PR7.name: Correct
PR7.explanation: The 3.6 kg mass value is not traceable to the provided context, and the 1 g condition conflicts with the ConOps statement that operation occurs on board the ISS (microgravity).
PR7.affected_text: 3.6 kg perpendicularly to normal gravity (9.81 m/s2)
PR7.suggested_replacement: 3.6 kg [cite source] under the 9.81 m/s² ground-test condition [cite justification]

ER1.name: Unambiguous
ER1.explanation: 'comparable to that of Earth' and 'low humidity' are qualitative descriptors without measurable definitions.
ER1.affected_text: an atmosphere comparable to that of Earth. Assume 21 degrees centigrade [70 degrees Fahrenheit], with low humidity
ER1.suggested_replacement: an atmosphere of 21 °C [70 °F] and a relative humidity of 25% to 50%

ER1.name: Singular
ER1.explanation: The statement bundles temperature, humidity, and pressure environmental constraints into one requirement.
ER1.affected_text: 21 degrees centigrade [70 degrees Fahrenheit], with low humidity, and pressurized to 100 kPA [750 mm Hg, 14.5 psi]
ER1.suggested_replacement: 21 °C [70 °F] (separate requirements to state humidity and pressure conditions)

ER1.name: Conforming
ER1.explanation: The requirement is split into a second 'Assume' sentence rather than a single conforming statement, and the pressure unit is mistyped as 'kPA' instead of 'kPa'.
ER1.affected_text: Assume 21 degrees centigrade [70 degrees Fahrenheit], with low humidity, and pressurized to 100 kPA [750 mm Hg, 14.5 psi].

ER2.name: Conforming
ER2.explanation: The requirement is phrased negatively ('shall not contribute') instead of as a positive statement.
ER2.affected_text: shall not contribute any particulates (e.g. dust) to the ISS atmosphere
ER2.suggested_replacement: shall contain all generated particulates (e.g., dust) within its enclosure

ER2.name: Unambiguous
ER2.explanation: 'any particulates' gives no measurable size or quantity threshold, so compliance cannot be uniquely interpreted or verified.
ER2.suggested_replacement: particulates larger than 100 µm, at a release rate exceeding [X] particles per operation

ER3.name: Necessary
ER3.explanation: The requirement mandates a specific design solution (enclosing components) rather than stating the needed characteristic of preventing lubricant release.
ER3.affected_text: shall enclose all lubricated components to prevent lubricants from leaking into
ER3.suggested_replacement: shall contain all lubricants used within it, preventing their release into

ER3.name: Appropriate
ER3.explanation: The statement addresses internal components (a subsystem-level detail) rather than a characteristic of the system of interest as a whole.

ER3.name: Conforming
ER3.explanation: The clause is expressed in a negative/prevention form rather than as a positive capability statement.
ER3.affected_text: to prevent lubricants from leaking into the atmosphere of the ISS
ER3.suggested_replacement: such that lubricants remain contained within the system during ISS operations

RR1.name: Conforming
RR1.explanation: The requirement is phrased negatively and uses the prohibited 'not ... more than' construction.
RR1.affected_text: shall not use more than 1.5 Watt-hours
RR1.suggested_replacement: shall consume 1.5 W·h or less of electrical energy

RR1.name: Correct
RR1.explanation: The 1.5 Watt-hour energy budget is not traceable to any stated stakeholder need, ConOps element, or supporting analysis.

RR1.name: Unambiguous
RR1.explanation: 'all operations' is undefined within the requirement; the note partially clarifies duration but not which operations are included.
RR1.suggested_replacement: to complete one displacement (FR1) and one return (FR2) cycle
